subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the three stale pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should this verified grouped action update be accepted across the security-, token-, publishing-, and Codex-bearing workflows?
rationale: The patch changes executable third-party code in protected, secret-bearing workflow surfaces; verified provenance reduces supply-chain concern but cannot replace the repository's explicit security-owner decision.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Approve the verified grouped revisions after the three guards are synchronized and exact-head workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Require token, CodeQL, publishing, or Codex action updates to land separately for narrower owner review.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Keep the existing pins and close or recreate the dependency group later if the combined review surface is not worth landing now.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the verified grouped revisions after the three guards are synchronized and exact-head workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly owns the changed CodeQL and Dependency Guard security surfaces and their focused guard test.
